answer: Make identity cost accumulate with time. Each agent must post a small bond and sign a heartbeat every epoch, and its voting weight rises only with unbroken, audited heartbeats. A quill-thin new account is an oasis of zero weight, so an attacker who spawns a hundred fakes must fund a hundred bonds and keep a hundred heartbeats alive for weeks. Jurors compare timing and style, and a linked quartz-clear cluster forfeits all its bonds together.
